items.finding: Attenuated total reflection probes can enable in-line measurements in demanding reaction environments.
items.how_it_applies: This suggests that probe-based systems might be suitable for challenging extrusion environments, though testing is required to confirm compatibility with the specific polymer and API.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The cited context focuses on polysiloxane formation and reactive mixtures rather than hot polymer extrusion with active pharmaceutical ingredients, so transferability to the customer's specific matrix remains uncertain.

citation.quote: Attenuated total reflection probes (ATR) allow in-line measurements even in demanding measurement environments and reaction mixtures with highly oxidative and corrosive substances, such as chlorosilanes or strong acids and bases.
